questions.stem: A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個長方形長 8 cm、闊 5 cm。求它的面積。
questions.hint: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
questions.hintZh: 長方形面積 = 長 × 闊。
questions.solution: Area = 8 × 5 = 40 cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A circle has radius 7 cm. Find its area in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓的半徑為 7 cm。以 π 表示它的面積。
questions.hint: Use A = πr².
questions.hintZh: 利用 A = πr²。
questions.solution: A = π × 7² = 49π cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 12 cm² and length 5 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個柱體的截面積為 12 cm²，長為 5 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Multiply the cross-sectional area by the length.
questions.hintZh: 將截面積乘以長度。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A cylinder has radius 3 cm and height 8 cm. Find its volume.
questions.stemZh: 一個圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 8 cm。求體積。
questions.hint: Use V = πr²h.
questions.hintZh: 利用 V = πr²h。
questions.solution: V = π × 3² × 8 = 72π cm³.
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: Find the total surface area of a closed cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 5 cm.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱的半徑為 3 cm，高為 5 cm。求總表面積。
questions.hint: Include both circular ends and the curved surface.
questions.hintZh: 包括兩個圓形底面及曲面。
questions.solution: A = 2πr² + 2πrh = 18π + 30π = 48π cm².
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: Two similar solids have corresponding lengths in the ratio 2 : 3. Find their volume ratio.
questions.stemZh: 兩個相似立體的對應邊長之比為 2 : 3。求體積之比。
questions.hint: Volume scales with the cube of the length scale factor.
questions.hintZh: 體積比等於長度比的三次方。
questions.solution: The volume ratio is 2³ : 3³ = 8 : 27.
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A sector has radius 6 cm and angle 120°. Find its area.
questions.stemZh: 一個扇形的半徑為 6 cm，圓心角為 120°。求面積。
questions.hint: A sector occupies θ/360 of the full circle.
questions.hintZh: 扇形佔整個圓的 θ/360。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A rectangle is 12 cm long and 7 cm wide. Find its area in cm². Enter only the number.
questions.stemZh: 長方形長 12 cm、闊 7 cm。求面積（cm²），只需輸入數值。
questions.solution: Area = 12×7 = 84 cm².
questions.hint: Multiply length by width.
questions.hintZh: 長方形面積等於長乘闊。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A prism has cross-sectional area 18 cm² and length 7 cm. Find its volume in cm³.
questions.stemZh: 柱體截面積為 18 cm²，長 7 cm。求體積（cm³）。
questions.hint: Multiply cross-sectional area by the length of the prism.
questions.hintZh: 柱體體積等於截面積乘長度。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: A closed cylinder has radius 4 cm and height 9 cm. (a) Find its volume. (b) Find its total surface area. Give exact answers in terms of π.
questions.stemZh: 一個密封圓柱半徑為 4 cm，高為 9 cm。(a) 求體積；(b) 求總表面積，以 π 表示答案。
questions.solution:
(a) V=πr²h=π×16×9=144π cm³.
(b) A=2πr²+2πrh=32π+72π=104π cm².
questions.hint: Use the volume formula, then include the two circular faces when finding total surface area.
questions.hintZh: 先用圓柱體積公式。求總表面積時，要包括兩個圓形底面。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習
rubric: 體積公式及答案 144π cm³ 正確。
包括兩個底面，總表面積為 104π cm²。
使用正確平方及立方單位。

questions.stem: Two similar closed cylinders A and B have radii in the ratio 2:3. A has radius 4 cm and height 10 cm. (a) Find the radius and height of B. (b) Find both volumes. (c) Find the ratio of their total surface areas. Explain each scale factor.
questions.stemZh: 兩個相似密封圓柱 A、B 的半徑比為 2:3。A 的半徑為 4 cm，高為 10 cm。(a) 求 B 的半徑及高；(b) 求兩者體積；(c) 求總表面積之比，並解釋各比例因子。
questions.solution:
(a) Linear scale factor is 3/2, so B has radius 6 cm and height 15 cm.
(b) VA=π×4²×10=160π cm³; VB=π×6²×15=540π cm³. Volume ratio is 8:27.
(c) Surface areas scale as the square of corresponding lengths, giving 4:9.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 長度比例因子為 3/2，B 半徑為 6 cm，高為 15 cm。
(b) VA=160π cm³，VB=540π cm³，體積比為 8:27。
(c) 面積比等於長度比的平方，故為 4:9。
questions.hint: Corresponding lengths have ratio 2:3. Square that ratio for areas and cube it for volumes.
questions.hintZh: 對應長度比為 2:3。面積比取平方，體積比取三次方。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習
rubric: B 半徑及高分別為 6 cm、15 cm。（2 分）
體積分別為 160π、540π cm³。（2 分）
清楚說明長度、面積及體積的比例關係。（2 分）

questions.stem: The figure shows rectangle ABCD. AB=8 cm and BC=6 cm. Find the area of triangle ABC.
questions.stemZh: 圖中 ABCD 為長方形，AB=8 cm、BC=6 cm。求三角形 ABC 的面積。
questions.solution: Area of triangle ABC = ½×AB×BC = ½×8×6 = 24 cm².
questions.solutionZh: 三角形 ABC 面積 = ½×8×6 = 24 cm²。
questions.hint: AB and BC are perpendicular. Use them as the base and height of triangle ABC.
questions.hintZh: AB 垂直 BC，可以分別作為三角形 ABC 的底和高。
questions.sourceZh: EAC 原創練習

questions.stem: In the figure, \(DE\parallel BC\) and \([ADE]:[ADC]=1:4\). Find \([DEC]:[BDC]\).
questions.stemZh: 如圖，\(DE\parallel BC\)，且 \([ADE]:[ADC]=1:4\)。求 \([DEC]:[BDC]\)。
questions.solution: Triangles ADE and ADC have bases AE and AC on the same line and a common altitude from D. Thus \(AE/AC=[ADE]/[ADC]=1/4\). Since \(DE\parallel BC\), similarity gives \(DE/BC=AE/AC=1/4\). Triangles DEC and BDC have bases DE and BC with equal heights between the parallel lines, so \([DEC]:[BDC]=1:4\).
questions.solutionZh: 先用同高三角形：\([ADE]/[ADC]=AE/AC=1/4\)。由 \(DE\parallel BC\) 及相似三角形得 \(DE/BC=1/4\)。再以 DE、BC 為底，兩三角形在平行線之間等高，所以 \([DEC]:[BDC]=1:4\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a parallelogram. E is the midpoint of AB; F and G lie on CD with \(DF=FG=GC\). BG and CE intersect at H. If \([BCH]=6\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of EFGH.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是平行四邊形，E 是 AB 的中點，F、G 三等分 CD，且 \(DF=FG=GC\)。BG 與 CE 交於 H。若 \([BCH]=6\text{ cm}^2\)，求 EFGH 的面積。
questions.solution: Normalize \(A=(0,0),B=(1,0),C=(1,1),D=(0,1)\). Then \(E=(1/2,0),F=(1/3,1),G=(2/3,1),H=(4/5,3/5)\). Base-height subtraction gives \([BCH]=1/10,[EFGH]=4/15\) of the parallelogram. Thus \(6(4/15)/(1/10)=16\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 把平行四邊形面積設為 1。按等分點定位交點，得 \(H=(4/5,3/5)\)（以相鄰兩邊為座標方向）。由底高及分割可得 \([BCH]=1/10,[EFGH]=4/15\)，所求為 \(6\times(4/15)/(1/10)=16\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a parallelogram and E lies on AB. EC and BD intersect at F. If \([DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\), find \([CBF]\).
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是平行四邊形，E 在 AB 上。EC 與 BD 交於 F。若 \([DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\)，求 \([CBF]\)。
questions.solution: Triangles DBC and DEC share base DC and have equal heights because E and B lie on AB parallel DC. Subtract common triangle DFC: \([CBF]=[DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 先認出等高同底。\([DBC]=[DEC]\)，因兩者同底 DC，而 B、E 在平行於 DC 的 AB 上。兩邊扣去共同的 \(\triangle DFC\)，得 \([CBF]=[DEF]=20\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABC, CDE and EFA are straight lines. \(BF\parallel CE\), \(AB:BC=2:3\) and \(CD:DE=1:4\). If \([ABF]=4\), find the area of BDEF.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，A、B、C 共線，C、D、E 共線，E、F、A 共線；\(BF\parallel CE\)，\(AB:BC=2:3\)，\(CD:DE=1:4\)。若 \([ABF]=4\)，求 BDEF 的面積。
questions.solution: Similarity gives \([ABF]/[ACE]=(2/5)^2=4/25\), so \([ACE]=25\). Triangles BCD and ACE share angle C, with side ratios \(CB/CA=3/5,CD/CE=1/5\). Hence \([BCD]=3\) and \([BDEF]=25-4-3=18\).

questions.stem: In the figure, F lies on BC with \(BF:FC=2:3\). D lies on AC; BD cuts AF at E with \(AE:EF=2:1\). If \([ABE]=12\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of CDEF.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，F 在 BC 上且 \(BF:FC=2:3\)。D 在 AC 上，BD 與 AF 交於 E，且 \(AE:EF=2:1\)。若 \([ABE]=12\text{ cm}^2\)，求 CDEF 的面積。
questions.solution: Since AE:EF=2:1, \([BEF]=6,[ABF]=18\). Thus \([ACF]=27\). To locate D use triangle ABC with \(BF/FC=2/3,AE/EF=2\): base-height ratios give \(AD:DC=4:5\). Hence \([ABD]=20,[ADE]=8\) and \([CDEF]=[ACF]-[ADE]=27-8=19\text{ cm}^2\).

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a rectangle. E is the midpoint of BC. AC and ED intersect at F. Find \([AEB]:[FCE]\).
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是長方形，E 是 BC 的中點，AC 與 ED 交於 F。求 \([AEB]:[FCE]\)。
questions.solution: Triangles FCE and FAD are similar with \(CE:AD=1:2\), hence F is at one-third of the rectangle height above BC. Since \(BE=CE\), triangles AEB and FCE have equal bases and height ratio 3:1. Therefore the area ratio is 3:1.
questions.solutionZh: 先由 \(\triangle FCE\sim\triangle FAD\) 得 \(CE:AD=1:2\)，所以 F 離 BC 的高度為長方形高度的 \(1/3\)。又 \(BE=CE\)，故兩三角形的面積比等於高比，即 3:1。

questions.stem: The figure shows trapezium ABCD with \(AD\parallel BC\). AFE, BFD and BEC are straight lines. \(BE:EC=BC:AD=1:3\) and \([ABF]=12\text{ cm}^2\). Find the area of CEFD.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)。A、F、E 共線，B、F、D 共線，B、E、C 共線；\(BE:EC=BC:AD=1:3\)，且 \([ABF]=12\text{ cm}^2\)。求 CEFD 的面積。
questions.solution: Set BC=1, AD=3, BE=1/4 and height=1 in affine coordinates. Choose \(B=(0,0),C=(1,0),A=(0,1),D=(3,1),E=(1/4,0)\). Then \(F=(3/13,1/13)\). The normalized areas are \([ABF]=3/26,[CEFD]=51/104\). Scale by \(12/(3/26)=104\) to obtain \(51\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 用平行底作座標方向：令 \(BC=1,AD=3,BE=1/4\)、高為 1。由兩直線相交得 \(F=(3/13,1/13)\)。底高分割得 \([ABF]=3/26,[CEFD]=51/104\)。實際面積比例因子為 104，故答案為 \(51\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a square. E and F are midpoints of AD and AB. G lies on BC with \(GC=3BG\); H lies on DC with \(HC=2DH\). If \([BFG]=3\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of EFGH.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是正方形，E、F 分別是 AD、AB 的中點。G 在 BC 上且 \(GC=3BG\)；H 在 DC 上且 \(HC=2DH\)。若 \([BFG]=3\text{ cm}^2\)，求 EFGH 的面積。
questions.solution: Let the square have area S. Then \([BFG]=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac14S=S/16\), so S=48. The four corner triangles have total fraction \(1/8+1/16+1/4+1/12=25/48\). Thus \([EFGH]=48(1-25/48)=23\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 先由 \([BFG]=\tfrac12\times\tfrac12\times\tfrac14S=S/16=3\) 得正方形面積 \(S=48\)。四個角的三角形面積佔比分別為 \(1/8,1/16,1/4,1/12\)。扣去後得 \([EFGH]=48\times23/48=23\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In triangle ABC, P lies on AB and Q lies on AC. \(AP:PB=2:1\) and \(AQ:QC=1:3\). Find \([BCP]:[BCQ]\).
questions.stemZh: 在 \(\triangle ABC\) 中，P、Q 分別在 AB、AC 上，\(AP:PB=2:1\)，\(AQ:QC=1:3\)。求 \([BCP]:[BCQ]\)。
questions.solution: Both triangles use BC as base. Their heights above BC are \(1/3\) and \(3/4\) of the height from A. Thus \([BCP]:[BCQ]=\tfrac13:\tfrac34=4:9\).
questions.solutionZh: 兩三角形共用底 BC。P、Q 離 BC 的高度分別為 A 的 \(1/3\) 及 \(3/4\)，故面積比為 \(\tfrac13:\tfrac34=4:9\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a trapezium with \(AD\parallel BC\) and \(AD:BC=1:3\). E lies on BC so ABED is a parallelogram; F is the midpoint of BC. DE and AF intersect at G. If \([EGF]=7\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of ABCD.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)，\(AD:BC=1:3\)。E 在 BC 上使 ABED 成為平行四邊形；F 是 BC 的中點。DE 與 AF 交於 G。若 \([EGF]=7\text{ cm}^2\)，求梯形 ABCD 的面積。
questions.solution: Normalize AD=BE=1, BC=3 and height h. Then EF=1/2. Similar triangles GAD and GFE give \(GF:GA=EF:AD=1:2\), so G is at height h/3 above BC. Hence \([EGF]=\tfrac12\cdot\tfrac12\cdot h/3=h/12\) while \([ABCD]=(1+3)h/2=2h\). The factor is 24, giving \(168\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 令 \(AD=BE=1,BC=3\)，梯形高為 h，則 \(EF=1/2\)。由相似三角形得 G 離 BC 的高度為 \(h/3\)，所以 \([EGF]=h/12\)，而梯形面積為 \(2h\)，是前者的 24 倍。答案 \(7\times24=168\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, ABCD is a trapezium with \(AD\parallel BC\) and \(AD:BC=3:2\). E lies on AD with \(AE:AD=1:3\). AC and BE intersect at F. If \([BCF]=8\text{ cm}^2\), find the area of ABCD.
questions.stemZh: 如圖，ABCD 是梯形，\(AD\parallel BC\)，\(AD:BC=3:2\)。E 在 AD 上，且 \(AE:AD=1:3\)。AC 與 BE 交於 F。若 \([BCF]=8\text{ cm}^2\)，求梯形 ABCD 的面積。
questions.solution: Let AD=3, BC=2 and height h, so AE=1. Similar triangles AEF and CBF give \(AF:FC=AE:BC=1:2\). Thus F has height 2h/3 above BC and \([BCF]=2h/3\). The trapezium area is \(5h/2\), giving ratio \(15/4\) and area \(8\times15/4=30\text{ cm}^2\).
questions.solutionZh: 令 \(AD=3,BC=2\)，高為 h，得 \(AE=1\)。由 \(\triangle AEF\sim\triangle CBF\) 得 \(AF:FC=1:2\)，故 F 離 BC 的高度為 \(2h/3\)。\([BCF]=2h/3\)，梯形面積為 \(5h/2\)，所以答案為 \(8\times15/4=30\text{ cm}^2\)。

questions.stem: In the figure, the solid consists of a right circular cone and a hemisphere with a common base. The base radius and the height of the circular cone are \(3\text{ cm}\) and \(4\text{ cm}\) respectively. Find the total surface area of the solid.
questions.stemZh: 圖中，該立體由一個直立圓錐及一個共享底面的半球組成。圓錐的底半徑及高分別為 \(3\text{ cm}\) 及 \(4\text{ cm}\)。求該立體的總表面積。
questions.hint: Curved surface area \(=\pi r l\). Slant height \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\).
questions.hintZh: 圓錐曲面面積 = \(\pi r l\)，總面積 = 曲面 + 底。斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
questions.solution: Q2. The cone slant height is \(l=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5\) cm. The common base is internal, so only the cone and hemisphere curved surfaces are exposed: \(S=\pi(3)(5)+2\pi(3)^2=33\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Answer B. Do not include either circular joining face.
questions.solutionZh: 圓錐斜高 \(l=\sqrt{3^2+4^2}=5\) cm。共享底面在內部，故只有圓錐曲面及半球曲面外露：\(S=\pi(3)(5)+2\pi(3)^2=33\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 B。

questions.stem: If the height of a regular tetrahedron is \(2\text{ cm}\), then the volume of the tetrahedron is
questions.stemZh: 若一個正四面體的高為 \(2\text{ cm}\)，則該四面體的體積為
questions.hint: Regular tetrahedron: \(h=\frac{\sqrt{6}}{3}a\), volume \(=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{12}a^3\).
questions.solution: Q3. All faces are congruent equilateral triangles. For edge length \(a\), the distance from the base centre to a base vertex is \(a/\sqrt3\). Pythagoras gives \(a^2=2^2+(a/\sqrt3)^2\), so \(a^2=6\). The base area is \((\sqrt3/4)a^2=3\sqrt3/2\), hence \(V=\frac13(3\sqrt3/2)(2)=\sqrt3\text{ cm}^3\). B. The given height is perpendicular height, not edge length.
questions.solutionZh: 正四面體高 \(h=\frac{\sqrt6}{3}a=2\)，得 \(a=\sqrt6\)。體積 \(V=\frac{\sqrt2}{12}a^3=\frac{\sqrt2}{12}(6\sqrt6)=\sqrt3\text{ cm}^3\)。答案 B。

questions.stem: In the figure, the base of a right prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 6 cm and 8 cm. The length of the prism is 10 cm. Find the volume of the prism.
questions.stemZh: 圖中所示為一個直立棱柱，底面為一直角三角形，兩股分別為 6 cm 及 8 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。
questions.hint: Prism volume = base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 棱柱體積 = 底面積 × 長度。
questions.solution: The base area is \(\frac12(6)(8)=24\text{ cm}^2\). The volume is \(24(10)=240\text{ cm}^3\). Answer B.

questions.stem: The base radius of a right circular cone is 2 times the base radius of a right circular cylinder while the height of the circular cylinder is 3 times the height of the circular cone. If the volume of the circular cone is \(36\pi\text{ cm}^3\), then the volume of the circular cylinder is
questions.stemZh: 一個直立圓錐的底半徑為一個直立圓柱底半徑的 2 倍，而圓柱的高為圓錐高的 3 倍。若圓柱的體積為 \(243\pi\text{ cm}^3\)，則圓錐的體積為
questions.hint: Use relevant volume/area formulas. Watch units.
questions.hintZh: 運用相關立體體積/面積公式，小心單位。
questions.solution: Q6. Let the cylinder radius be \(r\) and cone height be \(h\). The cone volume is \(\frac13\pi(2r)^2h=\frac43\pi r^2h\); the cylinder volume is \(\pi r^2(3h)=3\pi r^2h\). Thus \(V_{\rm cylinder}/V_{\rm cone}=9/4\), giving \((9/4)(36\pi)=81\pi\text{ cm}^3\). C. Use the separate solid formulae; these solids are not similar.

questions.stem: In the figure, the base of a solid right triangular prism is a right-angled triangle with legs 8 cm and 15 cm. The length of the prism is 10 cm. Find the volume of the prism.
questions.stemZh: 圖中，該實心直立三角棱柱的底面為一直角三角形，兩股分別為 8 cm 及 15 cm。棱柱的長度為 10 cm。求該棱柱的體積。
questions.hint: Prism volume = base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 三角底面積 = ½ × 底 × 高。
questions.solution: The base area is \(\frac12(8)(15)=60\text{ cm}^2\). The volume is \(60(10)=600\text{ cm}^3\). Answer B.

questions.stem: The base of a solid right pyramid is a square of side \(18\text{ cm}\). If the height of the pyramid is \(12\text{ cm}\), then the total surface area of the pyramid is
questions.stemZh: 一個實心直立錐體的底面為邊長 \(18\text{ cm}\) 的正方形。若錐體高 \(12\text{ cm}\)，則錐體的總表面積為
questions.hint: Pyramid volume = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 錐體體積 = \(\frac{1}{3}\) × 底面積 × 高。
questions.solution: Q8. The face slant height runs to the midpoint of a base edge, so \(l=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15\) cm. Add four triangular faces and the square base: \(S=4(\frac12\times18\times15)+18^2=864\text{ cm}^2\). D. The perpendicular pyramid height \(12\) cm is not the triangular face height.
questions.solutionZh: 斜面高至底邊中點：\(l=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15\) cm。四面三角面加正方形底：\(S=4\left(\frac12\times18\times15\right)+18^2=540+324=864\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 D。

questions.solution: Q9. Cancel the unknowns \(a,b\) using a volume ratio: \(\frac{V_{\rm cone}}{V_{\rm cylinder}}=\frac{(1/3)(7a)^2(5b)}{(5a)^2(7b)}=\frac7{15}\). Hence \(V_{\rm cone}=525\times\frac7{15}=245\text{ cm}^3\). B. Retain the cone factor \(1/3\).

questions.stem: The base of a solid right prism is a regular 6-sided polygon of side 8 cm. If the volume of the prism is \(288\text{ cm}^3\), find the total surface area of the prism correct to the nearest \(\text{cm}^2\).
questions.stemZh: 一個實心直立棱柱的底面為邊長 \(8\) cm 的正六邊形。若棱柱的體積為 \(288\text{ cm}^3\)，求棱柱的總表面積，準確至最接近的 \(\text{cm}^2\)。
questions.hint: Prism volume = base area × height.
questions.hintZh: 柱體體積 = 底面積 × 高。先搵底面積。
questions.solution: Q10. Split the regular hexagon into six equilateral triangles: \(A=6(\sqrt3/4)(8)^2=96\sqrt3\text{ cm}^2\). The prism height is \(h=288/(96\sqrt3)=\sqrt3\) cm. Thus \(S=2A+(6\times8)h=240\sqrt3\approx415.692\text{ cm}^2\), which rounds to \(416\text{ cm}^2\). C. Keep exact radicals until the final rounding.
questions.solutionZh: 正六邊形面積 \(=6(\sqrt3/4)(8)^2=96\sqrt3\text{ cm}^2\)。棱柱高 \(h=288/(96\sqrt3)=\sqrt3\) cm。\(S=2(96\sqrt3)+(6\times8)(\sqrt3)=240\sqrt3\approx416\text{ cm}^2\)。答案 C。
